anf_compare.notes: No public-domain English of On Pascha exists (Toura 1941; Daly ACW 54 and Witte's German are copyrighted and were not copied). Sense checked against the locked Witte Greek (and, for 1.94, Victor of Capua's Latin as Witte prints it) and the wording of the cited scriptures.

bible_refs.note: The lamb who takes away the sin of the world.
Caiaphas, high priest that year, speaking without knowing.

pass_a_gloss: These things the true sheep, the truly lamb who takes away the sin of the world, the only one dying so that the whole nation of humans may be saved, according to the high priest of that year, who not knowing was speaking.
pass_b_english: These things the true sheep, the true lamb who takes away the sin of the world, the only one dying so that the whole nation of human beings may be saved — according to the high priest of that year, who was speaking without knowing (John 1:29) (John 11:49–51).
source_text: Ταῦτα τὸ ἀληθινὸν πρόβατον, ὁ ἀληθῶς ἀμνὸς ὁ αἴρων τὴν ἁμαρτίαν τοῦ κόσμου, ὁ μόνος ἀποθνήσκων ἵνα τὸ πᾶν ἔθνος ἀν(θρώπ)ων σωθῇ κατὰ τὸν ἀρχιερέα τοῦ ἐνιαυτοῦ ἐκείνου, ὃς οὐκ εἰδὼς ἔλεγεν.
